<a id="supported-repair-and-reformation-of-a-sustaining-relation--仍受支持的修复与维持关系再形成"></a>
# Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`supported-renewal-recovery` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](supported-renewal-recovery.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Restoration is a law of every balanced flow: joint net giving over enough steps raises a condition's level to any target. In the support-gated law a supported contribution route restores the sustaining activity as an instance, while two actual histories with the same later inputs recover or do not.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For every balanced flow on every web, restoration is a law: a step of joint net giving raises a condition's level by at least one, and where the formations give jointly more than they take at each step at which the level is not below where it started, m − level steps bring the level to at least m. (`Becoming.Flow.net_give_raises_at`, `Becoming.Flow.net_give_bounded_at`, `Becoming.Flow.restores_at`, `Becoming.Flow.restores`)
2. Every law of the support-gated family is such a flow on its static web, so its restoration of the sustaining need is an instance, with the statement of the family theorem: within the existing support-gated law, an initially supported contribution route with positive net contribution throughout a deficit-length window keeps its own support and restores the sustaining activity. (`Becoming.SupportGated.renewal`, `Becoming.SupportGated.netGive`, `Becoming.SupportGated.flow`, `Becoming.SupportGated.web`, `Becoming.SupportGated.balances`, `Becoming.SupportGated.netGive_step`, `Becoming.SupportGated.repair_restores`, `RenewalRecovery.supported_repair_step`, `Becoming.SupportRecovery.repair_step`, `RenewalRecovery.repair_window_progress`, `Becoming.SupportRecovery.window_progress`, `RenewalRecovery.repair_restores_sustaining_support`)
3. If both activities lack support, the reached level remains constant despite later nominal contributions. (`RenewalRecovery.inactive_pair_absorbs`, `Becoming.SupportRecovery.absorbs`)
4. Two actual draw histories have the same initial level and later inputs but opposite recovery outcomes; the recovered history is neither all-time renewing nor permanently consuming, and its supported pulse is an instance of the law of restoration. (`RenewalRecovery.same_future_inputs`, `Becoming.SupportRecovery.same_later_inputs`, `RenewalRecovery.two_actual_pulses`, `Becoming.SupportRecovery.pulse_levels`, `RenewalRecovery.supported_pulse_recovers`, `Becoming.SupportRecovery.supported_pulse_recovers`, `RenewalRecovery.unsupported_pulse_never_recovers`, `Becoming.SupportRecovery.unsupported_pulse_ends`, `RenewalRecovery.recovered_history_neither_global_class`, `Becoming.SupportRecovery.recovered_neither`, `Becoming.SupportGated.pulse_restores`, `Becoming.SupportGated.repair_restores`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- One natural-number condition, two threshold-supported activities and the inherited recurrence. Contribution and drawing enter actual change only while the focal activity is supported; sustaining renewal is likewise support-gated.
- Finite recovery requires initial repair support and contrib > draw at each of the next needG − level T steps; the schedule and its source are supplied.
- Non-recovery is restricted to the same law with both activities unsupported, no third injection, threshold revision or condition substitution; pulse witnesses supply exact initial values, thresholds and inputs.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The family's balance as a flow holds by construction (the focal take is what the step removes); the instance's content is its supported givers and arithmetic. Witness: `Becoming.SupportGated.balances`.
- Does not derive contribution sources, activity selection, physical laws, general recoverability, whole-Becoming relational constitution or ethical necessity; living significance, the practical commitments and E stay explicit.
- Finite recovery does not guarantee later maintenance.
- **Counterexample:** unsupported_pulse_never_recovers refutes guaranteed recovery from a later contribution schedule alone; recovered_history_neither_global_class retains the interruption rather than replacing dynamics with a global label. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RenewalRecovery.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Earlier material repair, initiation obstructions and continuous recovery basins remain earlier results; the delta is the finite window, absorbing state and actual-history comparison in this inherited gated law. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RELATIONAL-BECOMING-INTEGRATION.md)

**Standard boundaries:** Premise-free (zero-substantive-axiom) grounding is a separate open target; completed results on the conditional alignment route keep their scope.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Sustaining, drawing and repair differentiate roles within one unfolding. The inherited Law.level supplies the repair-window start; per-step progress through repair_window_progress feeds the original sustaining-support test. A first-draw difference changes actual repair support; later nominal inputs are not actual supply. No empirical correspondence to a real system is established.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **application**: [relational-renewal-classification](relational-renewal-classification.md). Applies the existing Law and unfolding definitions; the prior no-return theorem is not a premise of positive recovery. The source module is freshly checked in this closure.
  - Output: The input history produces level T, activity support and the gated recurrence.
  - Input: Support at the repair-window start and finite positive net contribution, or simultaneous loss of both supports.
  - Preserved conditions: Same law, thresholds and recurrence; no third supply. The positive theorem adds the finite-window premise. [RenewalRecovery.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RenewalRecovery.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [renewing-consuming-formation](renewing-consuming-formation.md). A separately checked wear law supplies depletion bounds; no import or model adapter is claimed here.
- related, not a proved adapter: [endpoint-loss-and-return](endpoint-loss-and-return.md). Reformation and return to an entire configuration are different targets; recovery does not erase interruption. Interpretive relation only.
